snippet.title: The Apartment - New Nightmare Trailer [Psychological Thriller Game]
snippet.description:
The Apartment is released on Steam on 26.1.2018! http://store.steampowered.com/app/752020

Game Info:
The Apartment is a small psychological thriller. Bizzare mix of first person detective adventure game, action and psychological horror with some interesting puzzles, all tied together with dark and heavy story

Links:
Twitter: https://twitter.com/AndrewKorecki
IndieDB: http://www.indiedb.com/games/the-apartmentgame
